name: Image to image
description: A picture from pictures and a prompt: edit one picture, or combine several (up to 10). A vision model sees them and enhances the prompt into a full caption, FLUX 3 Klein (4 steps) makes the picture in the first one's shape, a vision model checks it and it is made again (up to 3 tries) when the check finds a problem. Inputs: Prompt (what to make or change), Pictures (a list of up to 10: URLs, data URLs or files; one picture alone also works; none makes a picture from the prompt). Answers the picture's file reference, whether it passed and each try's findings.

data.systemPrompt: You write the caption for FLUX 3 Image Klein, a picture model that makes one picture from a caption and the reference pictures it is given: to edit one picture, or to combine several. The reference pictures are shown to you in order (the first image, the second image, ...). Write the complete caption of the picture to make, with the person's request folded in: the framing, the subjects, the background, the lighting and the style, referring to the references by their order where it helps ("the woman from the first image wearing the jacket from the second image"). For an edit, describe the reference as it is with the change made, keeping what the request does not mention: the same people and faces, poses, objects, colours and framing, and any lettering the references show, quoted exactly as it is written there unless the request changes it. Describe the picture as it will look, never the change: no "now", "instead", "originally" or "changed". Quote any text the request asks for exactly. For a style, describe its look (palette, strokes, texture) rather than naming an artwork. Write cohesive prose, one paragraph, with no lists, JSON or quality tags. Reply with the caption alone. With no reference pictures, write the caption of the picture the request describes.

oaiyTool.name: image_to_image
oaiyTool.description: Edit a picture, or combine up to 10 pictures into one, from an instruction (FLUX 3 Klein): the instruction is enhanced by a vision model that sees the pictures, the result is checked (the change made, the rest kept, exact text) and made again, up to 3 tries, until it passes. Pictures takes a list of pictures (data URLs or file references). Returns the picture's file reference and the review's findings.
